title: The Spectator Eyes
summary: Casts two Spectator rays, each once per Long Rest.

fields.Ray of Fear: Level 3, Action, 60 ft, once per Long Rest. Wisdom save against spell save DC avoids Frightened for 2 turns. Frightened prevents movement and gives disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.
fields.Wounding Ray: Level 3, Action, 60 ft, once per Long Rest. Deal 2d8 Necrotic, Constitution save against spell save DC for half.
fields.Acquisition: Spectator at the Petrified Battlefield in the Underdark.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
